2122010780107260041.en_summary: Another week, and silver open interest keeps rising. Implied deficits are increasing, contango keeps falling, and physical inventories in Shanghai and on COMEX have now been declining for several weeks. No red boxes this week and three green ones. Not thinking about selling silver investments.)
